title: Leaving the Sanctuary
narrative: Under the veil of deep desert dusk, the Prophet ﷺ and Abu Bakr step out from the shelter of the cave, beginning the quiet trek toward the coastal sands.

encounters.title: The Trusted Guide
encounters.brief: Abdullah ibn Urayqit arrives with the two camels.
encounters.narrative: A skilled navigator who knew the untraveled trails along the Red Sea coast, hired to steer clear of typical merchant routes.

title: The Coastal Track
narrative: Steering far west toward the Red Sea shoreline to evade the Quraish scouting parties scanning the main northern trade route.

encounters.title: The Pursuit of Suraqah
encounters.subtitle: The sinking hooves in solid sand
encounters.brief: Spurred by the bounty of 100 camels, a warrior spots the distant caravan.
encounters.narrative: Every time Suraqah approached, his horse's legs sank deep into the firm earth as if into mire. After three attempts, he asked for safety and promised to turn pursuers away.
